subject.title: feat(config): add canonical group-policy scope-tree resolver

question: Should the public scope-tree resolver require explicit provider identity, or should it reproduce the existing channel-to-messageProvider fallback internally?
rationale: This determines the permanent plugin SDK contract and whether future channel migrations can silently lose channel-prefixed sender-policy matching.

options.title: Require provider identity
options.body: Make provider identity mandatory for scope tool-policy resolution and update every migration caller and compatibility test accordingly.

options.title: Preserve the fallback
options.body: Accept a channel parameter and internally default `messageProvider` exactly as the existing generic resolver does.

options.title: Keep the resolver internal
options.body: Delay the plugin SDK exports until several channel migrations establish the correct reusable contract.

recommendation.title: Require provider identity
recommendation.body: Make provider identity mandatory for scope tool-policy resolution and update every migration caller and compatibility test accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: This person designed both the foundational API and its first dependent migration, making them the strongest available owner for the contract decision.
